notes.title: DEMO v0.1.20 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we're the development team of Halcyon Days at Taoyuan.

First and foremost, we’d like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support and feedback, which has been a tremendous encouragement to us!





Based on your suggestions, we’ve optimized several features in the DEMO to enhance your gaming experience.
Here’s a full list of this update’s contents:

Added a rumor system: Visit Wanhuan to hear villagers’ gossip and choose whether to lend a hand.

Reworked the task tracking panel.

Added the ability to delete tasks.

Improved the logic for updating pinned tasks.

Adjusted the water-adding mechanic for the livestock shed—it now consumes water from buckets according to actual needs.

Updated in-game documentation regarding the R key functionality.

Fixed an issue where item details in chests were displayed incompletely.

Fixed a visual bug where trees at the bottom of the farm obstructed the construction area.





If you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to join our QQ group (205068596) or reach out through other channels.
We promise to take every piece of feedback seriously!

notes.title: DEMO v0.1.19 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone from the Halcyon Days at Taoyuan dev team!

Once again, huge thanks for playing our demo and sharing your feedback—your enthusiasm fuels our progress!





Based on your suggestions, we've rolled out these improvements:

Social Panel Revamp：

Added NPC profiles with exact favorability metrics, gift preferences, and basic info

Reserved space for future "Story Recap" feature

Display Optimizations：

Added borderless window mode

Fixed intermittent resolution-switching failures

Removed unstable resolutions (known to cause screen flickering)

Expanded wooden deck area at Xiao Family Fishing Boat dock

Upgraded tools now arrive via carrier pigeon delivery (no pickup needed!) 

Added Contribution Value display to obtained items

Upgraded ore visuals with improved collision physics

Fixed ESC key conflict (no longer opens Settings when closing panels)





Have thoughts? Join our QQ Group (205068596) or reach out—we read every submission!

notes.title: v0.1.18 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are the development team of Halcyon Days at Taoyuan.



First and foremost, thank you all for playing and sharing your feedback—it has been incredibly helpful!



Based on your suggestions, we’ve made several minor optimizations to enhance your gaming experience.
Below are all the updates in this patch:
➢ Added a single-use item, \[Huicheng], allowing quick teleportation from inside the cave to its entrance.
➢ Reduced the number of chambers leading to the cave’s boss room.
➢ Added a feed station in Le Hongdi’s courtyard—players can now borrow feed for free.
➢ Fixed a bug where story dialogues could get stuck.
➢ Optimized the issue where wall decorations couldn’t be picked up after removal; they are now automatically added to your backpack.



If you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to join our QQ group (205068596) or reach out through other channels.
We will carefully consider every piece of feedback you share!

notes.title: Game release date adjustment
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am very sorry to inform you that our game has to be postponed. 
The internal beta version is expected to wait until the end of 2024; the official version is expected to be postponed to the end of 2025.

Let me explain to you, there are three main reasons why the game is delayed:
First, due to our lack of experience, we made a big mistake in estimating the game production time - we only calculated the time for making new features and forgot to calculate the time for testing and bugs, which resulted in repeated delays in the production progress. 
The second is that we overestimated our physical condition - at first we worked crazy overtime with faith and enthusiasm, thinking that we could make up for the mistake we made in the first point, but soon we discovered that no matter how strong our mental strength was, our The mortal body cannot withstand long-term and high-intensity work. Not to mention minor ailments such as cervical spondylosis and tenosynovitis. The most serious thing is that our art teacher is so tired that he would faint at home.
The third problem is the game itself - in fact, in May, we released an internal demo and invited our relatives and friends to try it out with great anticipation. However, we received frustrating feedback - due to the lack of in-game guidance, players didn't know what to do in the game. As a result, although the game had rich content, players had no motivation to try it. After reflection and discussion, we decided to increase the priority of guidance and plot production, and increase the emphasis on this area. So we need more time to make and refine the game.
 
Finally, I would like to sincerely apologize to everyone. Due to our lack of experience in game production, this has led to such a result. I am very sorry! ! !

But we promise that no matter what setbacks we suffer, we will adhere to the original intention of "making games seriously" and finish "Taoyuan Village Diary" seriously! !
